HexKagune 1.0.13 for Forge 1.20.1 (needs PlayerAnimator, bendy-lib and Photon on clients; the server needs only Forge). Install on both the client and the server; everyone on a server needs this jar.

**War's six abilities, rebuilt from scratch**
- **Z King's Execution (12 s).** Point your hand: five black centipedes (the Centipede Form's legs, in black) burst out of your arm at whatever you aim at, up to 15 blocks away. They coil round it and hold it in the air, squeezing it with bone cracks every few ticks, then crush it: a big hit, a stun and a bleed. Anything over 150 max health is too big to lift, so it's crushed where it stands.
- **J Black Reaper (15 s).** You dash up to 10 blocks where you're looking and stop short of walls, leaving a trail of Photon embers. At the end you bring the bladed arm down in a heavy cleave across everything in front of you. It cuts deep and makes them bleed, and what it kills is cut in half: the top half slides off along the cut and tips over, spraying blood. That works on humanoid models such as zombies, skeletons and piglins; players and other bodies bleed out where they fall.
- **G Centipede Dominion (40 s).** For 7 seconds you become a small Dragon (about 27 blocks long, a quarter of the great one's girth), with its heads, legs and eyes. It crawls forward on its own and turns where you aim, tearing through terrain. The front jaws bite, the side heads snap at anything beside it, and the body crushes what it rolls over. It hits much softer than the awakening Dragon. The camera follows from behind and above it. While you're the Dragon your own body takes no damage, and when it ends you burst out of the ground under its head.
- **B Spire Wave (15 s).** You slam your arm into the ground, and a wave of black centipede spikes erupts in a line 20 blocks ahead, following the ground. They impale and launch whatever they hit, then pin it for a second. That sets up Z nicely.
- **C King's Defiance (16 s).** You raise the bladed arm. If anything hits you in the next 0.6 s, you take none of it: you blink behind the attacker and slash them, adding back the damage they tried to deal, then stun and bleed them. If nothing comes, the rinkaku wrap you in a cocoon for 3 s and absorb every hit, then explode outward, hitting harder the more they stored (up to 60).
- **V Black Sun (90 s).** The mask's eye opens a black sun above you, and everything within 30 blocks is slowed and swallowed in darkness. For 4 seconds you stand rooted while centipede spikes rain from the sky onto every hostile mob in range, and onto anything that attacked you recently. They kill anything at 30% health or less (up to 300 max health). It ends in a huge black crescent shockwave.

The rinkaku's own instinct (lashing and spiking what attacks you) stays as it was. Each ability now has its own War pose, and the menu card and HUD show the new names.

**What's checked:** the build passes the full verifier and the dedicated-server check, and 158 logic checks cover the new abilities' ranges, timings, sweeps and executes. The effects, poses and the small Dragon were checked in renders made with the game's own model code. **None of this has been played in game yet**, so if something looks off in motion (the small Dragon's camera, the halves, the cocoon), tell me what you saw.
